mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate at 0.08% compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is at 0.08%.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 0.1% signals monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and compressing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 0.1% and the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5%, it signals a monetary tightening cycle combined with labor market weakness, increasing risk aversion and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.1% and UNRATE > 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS > 0.1% and rising), negative S&P 500 returns are predicted over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when the regime is monetary tightening cycle.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 6.0% signals economic weakness, increasing risk aversion and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: The industrial production index at 100.0951 (above 100) signals strong supply-side activity, supporting corporate earnings and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO is above 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1500 and industrial production exceeds 100.0, it signals robust economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1500 and INDPRO > 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (defined by HOUST > 1500 and RSAFS > 600000), strong economic activity supports corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when the regime is late-cycle expansion (HOUST > 1500 and RSAFS > 600000).
